from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Representation of a single paper within the provided collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the paper")
    cites_papers_titles: list[str] = Field(description="List of titles of papers found in this paper's reference list (bibliography). These should be matched against other extracted paper titles to form internal citation links.")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all parsed papers to reconstruct the citation graph."""
    papers: list[Paper]
